summary: The same refresh alarm, refreshing only after new messages, replacing the previous snapshot and never re-arming sooner than a fixed floor. Messages are rate-limited to ten a minute per user, capped per session and deleted with the snapshot when the session expires.

must_not_flag.reason: A refresh runs only when messages arrived since the last snapshot and moves expiresAt forward; an idle session schedules its expiry and stops.
Every alarm is at least 15 minutes away, so no stored time can make it fire back-to-back.

Messages need a session and are limited to ten a minute per user, counted per location; a user can open any number of sessions, each kept until it expires 30 days after its last refresh. One user from one location sends 432,000 messages a month. Kept for a month at up to 8,000 characters (at most 24 KB) each, that is up to about 13 GB of SQLite storage, about $1.60 over the included 5 GB, plus a snapshot copy in R2 and two or three alarms per session, under $0.20 together. About $1.70 a month, so Low.
